v1.0.2

Patch: matchConditions fix (issue 08) for the 1.0.0 line, zero verdict
impact. Replaces matchConstraints.objectSelector (flattened across every
installed ValidatingPolicy into one shared webhook, last-reconciled wins --
breaks multi-version coexistence) with a per-policy matchConditions CEL
expression. Content otherwise identical to v1.0.0/v1.0.1 -- Audit
require-department-label, Deny require-known-department-label, same
known-department set. Cut alongside v2.0.2 so both older lines coexist
correctly with v2.2.0 (issue 08's full 3-version proof).
